text:
maya: FYI scheduling APAC (apac-west1) maintenance WED 23:00-01:00 UTC. Goal: NIC microcode + nvlink driver patch across GPU racks. We'll do 4 staggered cohorts to keep availability. Expect ~10-15% capacity dip while a cohort reboots.

alex: Sounds good. Which pools are in-scope? Any customers to exempt?

maya: Pools: tag:apac-gpu-general, apac-gpu-spot-burst. Exclude tenant-priority and dedicated-reserved pools. Tenant-retail-x and tenant-health-y notified.

sam: Drop runbook + drain commands pls.

maya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-midweek-maint. Drain snippet:
```
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# wait for pod eviction + verify
```

natalie: We'll run canary seed for KV cache after first node comes up? Cold starts killed last time.

alex: Yes: canary nodes (gpu-node-101/102). Reboot -> after node Ready wait 10m -> manual kv-seed -> smoke tests. Autoscripts will run a seed at ~15m but I'll do manual for canary.

tony: Finance question: any expected egress spike due to cross-region fallbacks? Need an estimate.

maya: Minimal. We estimate ~2% extra egress for the window; finance signed off. See ops doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/maint-costs/apac-2026-03.

sam: I'll post a console banner 2h before and notify customers with medium+ SLA risk. Draft notice: "Planned maintenance in APAC tonight; brief latency blips possible for some hosted requests. No data loss expected."

alex: Monitoring checklist:
- preflight: canary seed + smoke green
- during: watch p50/p95 latency, queue depth, dispatch errors
- post: KV hit-rate, cold-start ratio, rollback if p95 > 2x baseline for >5m

natalie: Also reduce trace sampling to avoid quota blow while debugging.

maya: Done. Sampling lowered to 5% for apac routes for window. Rollout policy set to auto-pause+rollback on p95 >2x for 5m.

infra-bot: scheduled-maintenance-bot: Created ticket MNT-7832. Cohorts a,b,c,d. Canaries: gpu-node-101, gpu-node-102.

alex: I'll run canary and report back.

sam: I'll update runbook with warmup commands from last quarter and ping #customer-ops.

infra-bot: scheduled-maintenance-bot: Cohort A started at 23:30 UTC.

alex: Canary complete, kv-seed ok, smoke tests green. Cohort A drained & rebooted, back in pool at 23:58. Latency within SLO. Proceeding to cohort B.

maya: Thanks. If anything spikes, trigger rollback immediately and notify customers. I'll post post-maint cost summary within 24h. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: scheduled-maintenance-bot: Maintenance complete across cohorts at 00:45 UTC. Peak cross-region traffic +1.8%, cost delta ~+1.9%. No SLA breaches reported.
